title: sorbus domestica var. lanuginosa
intro: Sorbus domestica var. lanuginosa, commonly known as the woolly whitebeam, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to help reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a mild sedative and a treatment for digestive issues, with its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids contributing to its effects. The bioactive constituents of Sorbus domestica var. lanuginosa, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
